# Jubilees Chapter 49 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Ge'ez MS; cf. 4QJub (Hebrew fragments) | **Section:** The Passover law — the most detailed Passover regulations in any ancient Jewish text

---

**49:1** "Remember the Passover command. You are to observe it at the right time: the fourteenth day of the first month. Slaughter the animal before evening. Eat the meal that night — on the evening of the fifteenth, beginning at sunset.

**49:2** It was on that very night that you were eating the Passover in Egypt — the first night of the festival, the beginning of the rejoicing — while Mastema's full force had been unleashed across Egypt, killing every firstborn: Pharaoh's firstborn, the firstborn of the lowest slave girl grinding at the mill, the firstborn of the livestock.

**49:3** Here is what the LORD's sign meant: wherever the blood of a year-old lamb was on the doorposts, the destroyer passed over that house and did not enter. That is why it is called Passover — the LORD passed over the houses of Israel.

**49:4** On that night, Mastema's destroying powers had no authority over Israel.

**49:5** The LORD personally shielded every Israelite household from the destroying angel. Not one person, not one animal, not even a dog was harmed.

**49:6** The destroyer could not enter the marked houses. The LORD's mark stopped him.

**49:7** When you enter the land God is giving you, you will observe this ordinance there in the same way, at the same time.

**49:8** Eat the meal on the fourteenth, between the two evenings — starting from a third of the way through the day, running through a third of the night. Two-thirds of the day is daylight; the final third is the evening.

**49:9** Follow the LORD's command exactly. Don't let the evening drift into darkness without eating; eat the meat while it is being cooked by fire, before morning comes.

**49:10** Don't break a single bone. This is written and fixed: leave nothing until morning, and break no bones. It is a feast. It is a day of joy.

**49:11** Eat it quickly. Head, legs, and entrails together. Unleavened bread and bitter herbs on the side. Drink wine — the blood of the grape.

**49:12** Don't carry the meat outside the gate. Don't break a bone. No uncircumcised person is permitted to eat.

**49:13** Every Israelite male must be circumcised. An uncircumcised male cannot eat the Passover. Period.

**49:14** Resident foreigners and hired workers may not eat it. It cannot be transported from one house to another. It is the most sacred food.

**49:15** Everyone in the household eats together, inside. No eating outside. No carrying meat out.

**49:16** All of Israel observes this — every year, one time, on the appointed day — exactly as commanded.

**49:17** Do not let the Passover slip past its day. This is the LORD's Passover, and it belongs to its day.

**49:18** I have written it in the heavenly tablets: the Passover is the fourteenth of the first month, and the sacrifice must be made before evening.

**49:19** The eating begins on the evening of the fifteenth and runs until a third of the night has passed. Whatever is left after that is to be burned.

**49:20** No boiling. No eating it raw. Only roasting over fire — the whole animal, head to legs to entrails.

**49:21** Not one bone broken. Not one.

**49:22** This is why the LORD commanded Israel: observe the Passover on its day, and do not break the bones.

**49:23** It is an eternal statute, carved into the heavenly tablets. There are no exceptions to this command."

---

*PNEUMA notes: Chapter 49 is the most detailed Passover legislation preserved from the Second Temple period, going beyond Exodus 12 in specifying exact timing, the role of Mastema as the destroyer, the wine drinking, and the absolute circumcision requirement. The repeated prohibition on breaking bones (vv.10, 12, 21, 22) is striking — Jubilees may be aware of the Johannine tradition that connects the unbroken bones of the Passover lamb to Jesus (John 19:36). The heavenly tablets authority (v.23) frames all the legislation as cosmically non-negotiable.*
